name: viashino_pyromancer_two_damage_to_a_planeswalker
notes: M4 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, it deals 2 damage to target player or planeswalker.' Seat 1 controls a planeswalker with 2 loyalty. Viashino Pyromancer enters and its trigger targets the planeswalker: 2 damage removes 2 loyalty and it is put into its owner's graveyard. Neither player loses life.
